facts.fact: President Chapo promulgated the Cybersecurity Law, protecting networks, information systems and critical infrastructure, with a regulatory body and penalties up to 160 minimum wages; reported by Lusa/Club of Mozambique, date is the article's published date.
President Chapo promulgated the Cybercrime Law in the same decree, strengthening prevention, investigation and punishment of digital crimes; date is the article's published date.
